items.source: The return value also follows the same rules as for @MessageMapping, except if the method is not annotated with SendTo or SendToUser, the message is sent directly back to the connected user and does not pass through the message broker. This is useful for implementing a request-reply pattern.
items.translation: 返回值也遵循与 `@MessageMapping` 相同的规则，除非该方法未使用 SendTo 或 SendToUser 注解，否则消息将直接发送回已连接的用户，而不会经过消息代理。这对于实现请求 - 回复模式非常有用。

items.source: This is the destination of the STOMP message (for example, "/positions"). Ant-style path patterns (for example, "/price.stock.*") and path template variables (for example, "/price.stock.{ticker}") are also supported.
items.translation: 这是 STOMP 消息的目的地（例如，`"/positions"`）。也支持 Ant 风格的路径模式（例如，`"/price.stock.*"`）和路径模板变量（例如，`"/price.stock.{ticker}"`）。

items.source: This is a method-level annotation that can be combined with a type-level @MessageMapping.
items.translation: 这是一个方法级注解，可以与类型级 @MessageMapping 组合使用。

items.source: Supports the same method arguments as @MessageMapping; however, subscription messages typically do not have a body.
items.translation: 支持与 `@MessageMapping` 相同的方法参数；然而，订阅消息通常没有正文。

items.source: NOTE: When using controller interfaces (for example, for AOP proxying), make sure to consistently put all your mapping annotations - such as @MessageMapping and @SubscribeMapping - on the controller interface rather than on the implementation class.
items.translation: 注意： 在使用控制器接口（例如用于 AOP 代理）时，请确保始终将所有的映射注解——如@MessageMapping和@SubscribeMapping——放在控制器接口上，而不是实现类上。

items.source: Destination-based mapping expressed by this annotation.
items.translation: 由该注解表示的基于目标的映射。
